2014_spells.otiluke-s-resilient-sphere.e: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.otiluke-s-resilient-sphere.f: Using 1 action, a sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's walls and thus roll the sphere at up to half the creature's speed. The effect lasts for up to 1 minute; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
